source.surface: document version history, an older version redlined against the current one, restore not yet chosen
source.attribution: Screen curated by Mobbin (https://mobbin.com). Inspected remotely through the Mobbin MCP under accessMode 'remote-mcp'. No image was downloaded, cached, embedded, or stored anywhere in this repository; every value below is our own reading of the rendered screen.

evidenceTier.rationale: Mobbin is a curated gallery of captured screens. It is not a live observation we made of a running product, and no audience outcome is attached, so it cannot be silver/M2 or gold/M3. Treat these facts as evidence that a shipped product once looked this way, not as evidence that it worked.

decisionColour.acceptControlTreatment: a filled control in the product's blue, rendered at noticeably lower saturation than the blue of the enabled Highlight-changes toggle sitting in the same bar
decisionColour.rejectControlTreatment: Close, set as unfilled label text immediately to its left
decisionColour.undecidedContainerTreatment: inserted text sits on a pale blue tint and deleted text is struck through in grey; changed paragraphs carry a blue rule in the left margin. The tint marks WHICH TEXT CHANGED and is applied to the historical version being previewed, not to the decision
decisionColour.verdict: The same blue is used for the change tint, the margin rules, the toggle, and the restore button. Because three of those four are non-committing, the button relies on shape and label rather than hue to be identified as the decision — the weakest hue separation in the observed set.
